p.title: apply-pending-records --help ran the real integration: version bump, every record written, pending files deleted
p.symptom: On 2026-11-04 theme-sector ran `node scripts/apply-pending-records.mjs --help` in its worktree. The script bumped to v59.70, recorded every thread's pending entries into the ledgers and deleted the pending files; it was reverted before any commit.
p.root_cause: apply-pending-records read only the flags it knew (--dry-run, --dir, a vNN.NN release) and ignored anything else, and its default with no flag was to write. record-fix and bump-version also ignored unknown flags; they did not write only because a missing positional argument stopped them.
p.fix: scripts/lib/cli-args.mjs parseCliArgs: an unknown argument fails before any file is read, --help/-h prints the usage and exits 0. apply-pending-records, record-fix and bump-version parse through it, and apply-pending-records writes only with an explicit --apply (--dry-run unchanged; no flag refuses).
p.violated_rule: A command that writes the ledgers or the version must never write on an argument it does not understand
p.prevention: ci-record-fix-check runs the three writers from a sandbox copy with --help, an unknown flag and (apply-pending-records) no flag, and asserts the exit codes and that nothing in the sandbox changed; against the pre-v59.70 scripts seven of these checks fail, and apply-pending-records --help reaches '1 pending record(s) -> v59.70'.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-record-fix-check.mjs (89 checks); the same gate with the three scripts from ff35bf0f fails 7 checks.

changelog: **Ledger writers refuse unknown arguments (v59.70, {P}):** `apply-pending-records`, `record-fix` and `bump-version` now fail on an argument they do not know, `--help` only prints the usage, and `apply-pending-records` writes only with `--apply` (`--dry-run` first, then `--apply`). An `apply-pending-records --help` had run the whole integration record step.

qa.text: v59.70: apply-pending-records, record-fix and bump-version exit 0 with the usage on --help, refuse an unknown argument, apply-pending-records refuses without --dry-run/--apply, and a sandbox copy is unchanged after all of them

note: 2nd batch A; orchestrator assignment after the theme-sector incident 2026-11-04. Docs: README updated; CLAUDE.md line 59 ('--dry-run 후 같은 명령으로') needs '--dry-run 후 --apply로' (left for the owner/orchestrator: this session does not edit CLAUDE.md on a peer request).
